question: What is long-term debt at year-end (0 if none)?
rationale: Started by analyzing per-doc rule coverage from eval_individual cache. Of 18 docs, only 4 are in D_star (correctly solved by full pool). All 4 D_star docs (ADOBE_2020/2021_10K, ACTIVISIONBLIZZARD_2020_10K, COSTCO_2018_10K) are 10-K balance-sheet style filings, so I focused on broad balance-sheet-debt rules. A 2-rule trial missed ACTIVISIONBLIZZARD_2020_10K; adding rule_long_term_debt_text_span as a third recovered it. Final set: 3 broad, multi-doc-type rules with sum_cost=0.056 (~8% of full pool 0.683) and min_cov=0.333 (max possible single-rule cov is 0.389, so >=0.4 unreachable).
